create_PerceiverTokenizer: create a PerceiverTokenizer instance with custom special tokens and max length
build_inputs_with_special_tokens: build model inputs by prepending CLS and appending SEP tokens to token sequences
get_special_tokens_mask: get a special tokens mask list marking special tokens as 1 and sequence tokens as 0
tokenize_text_with_Perceiver: tokenize a string into individual UTF-8 byte characters as Perceiver tokens
convert_tokens_to_string: convert a sequence of Perceiver tokens back into a single decoded UTF-8 string
